0f551747-4e7e-480e-88d8-1112537dec76/Eve.en: "Slaying demons and eradicating evil, I shall contribute my part..."<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> solemnly buried the hilt of <color=#yellow>Spiritsealer</color> where the Demon-Sealing Light cast by Tainted fell.<NL>From within the Demon-Sealing Light, Dayue Yaochang materialized, smiling.<NL>Then, the Light emitted a brilliant glow, and Dayue Yaochang vanished...
